snippet.title: Terra Invicta - Dark Skies DLC Trailer | Grand Strategy Game
snippet.description:
Explore two new starting scenarios in Terra Invicta's first DLC, Dark Skies, and face the existential threat of an alien invasion with new challenges and opportunities. Drop into a world shattered by nuclear fire over a century ago, or rewind to 2003 and trade the rush to the stars for a longer, slower fight on Earth!

Terra Invicta - Dark Skies will release on July 27th on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, and the Microsoft Store!

Wishlist on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4713340/Terra_Invicta__Dark_Skies
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/terra_invicta_dark_skies
EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/p/terra-invicta-dark-skies-ef4897
Microsoft Game Store: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9P25LD60779K
